Current analytics, security, compliance, ownership, affiliate, and rollback evidence for these scaffold sites remain unknown or incomplete; do not invent telemetry, add domains, spend, deploy, or launch. After that, admit only the complicated.work readiness brief, subject to owner, legal, security, measurement, and rollback gates.
